research.title: Specular reflection
research.note: Supplies the About page fact "Why a mirror turns the beam": On the bench the angle is always a quarter turn: a slash or a backslash mirror sends a beam off at a right angle.

research.title: Dispersion (optics)
research.note: Supplies the About page fact "Why a prism splits white light": The prism here is simplified to two beams, S for short and L for long, one leaving on each side. Real light does not split into just two.

research.title: Optical filter
research.note: Supplies the About page fact "What a filter does": An S filter and an L filter work the same way on the bench: they keep one kind of beam and stop the other.

research.title: Lunar Laser Ranging experiment
research.note: Supplies the About page fact "Mirrors left on the Moon": A beam, a few mirrors and a sensor that waits to be lit: the bench is the smallest version of the same set-up.

other.title: Pyodide
other.note: Runs the game's Python rules in the browser through WebAssembly (version 0.26.4, loaded from a CDN), so the game needs no server of its own and no build step.
